name: Towering Presence
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You adjust your posture and seem to suddenly overshadow all others around you. The subject gets a +10 enhancement bonus on Intimidation checks. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at caster level 7th, and to +30 (the maximum) at caster level 13th.
